lines.text: First konbini in Japan.|Grabbed a bag.
Warm and cold…|never share a bag.
Then she packed|it like a pro.
Three yen.|Two bags. Zero soggy onigiri.
At a konbini,|the bag costs 3 yen.|And warm and cold|never share one.
One bag for hot food.|One bag for cold drinks.
Say yes to the bag —|and let them sort it.
That's Japan first times.|Follow for more.
